cases.name: one tile between two colours
cases.why: the inversion in one move: a tile that gathers all three bursts, and two of a colour together are worth nothing

cases.name: one tile opens four beds
cases.why: the ceiling the rules allow - the cell it lands on and the four beside it, and nothing can ever open six

cases.name: a tile already blooming is not counted again
cases.why: the bug the obvious implementation writes: asking whether a neighbour has all three except this colour takes away a channel it had from somewhere else

cases.name: stone takes no tile and passes no light
cases.why: a bed beside stone has fewer neighbours to gather from, which is the whole of what stone does

cases.name: a heartbed refuses every colour but its own
cases.why: the order of the basket becomes the puzzle: the wrong tile cannot be planted there at all, so it has to be composted past

cases.name: a bed walled off is proved unopenable
cases.why: a search that reported this as timed out rather than lost would ship a level nobody can finish

cases.name: only a prism opens a pocket
cases.why: one open neighbour, so the bed and that neighbour carry two channels between them and never three
